description: xUnit conformance tests that check an implementation's real public types and its System.Text.Json serialization against the declared types.

supports.description: Public type and property presence, CLR type of each property, nullability annotation and read-only (immutable) properties.
JSON member names, required members, enum string values and round-trip of a contract-conforming payload through System.Text.Json.
Exact decimal values survive serialization without floating-point conversion.

unsupported.reason: Routines are qualified by the SQL and PowerShell profiles.

tooling.purpose: Builds and runs the generated xUnit project against the implementation assembly.

proofLimits: The tests check public shape and serialization only; business behavior is never generated or asserted.
A pass against a fixture assembly does not qualify a different implementation assembly.

checks.claim: The generated xUnit project builds against the implementation assembly.
The generated xUnit tests pass against the conforming implementation fixture and fail against the violating fixture.
checks.limits: Public shape and serialization subset only.
